title: Click-pen cam and latch compound joint
goal: Convert repeated button presses through a cylindrical cam, spring, and latch state machine into alternating tip extension and retraction.
constraints: Button, cam, latch, spring, and refill motion must remain physically coupled.
Latch state is established from contact and motion evidence rather than a scripted state variable alone.

The registered plugin is active, but the retractable_ballpoint_pen_v1 exemplar was never KINEMATIC_CERTIFIED through r150; r150 stopped at PHYSICAL_PREFLIGHT_FAILED with approximately 0.001717 m button-cam penetration, so its tasks are not admitted automatically.

approval.basis: Imported from retractable_ballpoint_pen_v1 at the user's request; task certification status is kept separate.
